note: Sounds made by the model MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 that the owner heard and accepted (verdict fits). Each one is a library sound that stands for one event of tools/audio/sounds.json. The raw files in assets/audio/generated are committed byte for byte, because a run of the model is not reproducible bit for bit and assets/audio/gen is ignored by git. tools/audio/build.py checks the sha256 of every raw file, cuts it as recorded, converts it to 48 kHz, repairs the ends and sets the integrated loudness to lufs. These lufs levels are the loudness of the rendered event the sound stands for, as assets/audio/render/manifest.json had it on 2026-11-16, and they are provisional until the mix of the game is designed. The owner heard the candidates at another level: they were levelled to -34 or -35 LUFS for the comparison. The two heavy hits stand for the same event. The thruster valve picks of round 5 were cut from raw files generated in round 4.
